purpose: Define the user-facing research result produced by the Family Law AI assistant.

result.title: Case or authority name
result.why_relevant: Source-grounded explanation of why the result matches the research question.

supporting_passage.text: verbatim source passage when legally permissible

result.connection: Explicitly labeled analytical connection between source and question.
result.limitations: What the source does not establish or what remains uncertain.

display_rules: Never display a relevance score without defining or exposing its contributing factors.
Never present model inference as quoted source material.
Keep supporting passages tied to a source locator.
Display contrary or limiting authority when material.
Treat primary-source verification as a first-class result attribute.
